purpose: Verify that the selected FrEDI_Data electricity slices at the pinned 2026 commit equal the electricity inputs embedded in FrEDI v4.1.1.
method: Loaded the pinned v4.1.1 sysdata.rda in R 4.4.2; joined response rows on sector/state/postal/model/variant/modelUnitValue and scalar rows on state/postal/year/scalarName; compared parsed numeric values.
conclusion: All selected current FrEDI_Data electricity rows align with the v4.1.1 embedded inputs. Nonzero differences are floating-point CSV serialization/parsing differences below the frozen absolute tolerance.
